Advisory

Fractional CFO

Executives need more than reports — they need insight. We provide high-level strategic support to improve cash flow, implement systems, sharpen forecasts, and drive confident decisions without paying for a full-time CFO.

Get a Free Consultation Browse Services
Forecasting & budgets Cash flow planning KPI reporting
Why it matters

When decisions are made without visibility, growth gets expensive. A fractional CFO adds clarity: what’s happening, what’s next, and what to do now.

  • Know your cash position weeks ahead (not after the fact)
  • See profitability by service line, customer, or location
  • Make hiring, pricing, and investment decisions with confidence

What we do

Executive-Level Support, Built for Real Life

We translate financials into decisions. That usually means a repeatable rhythm of reporting, forecasting, and strategic planning tailored to your stage of growth.

Dashboards & KPI Reporting

Clear metrics that show what’s driving revenue, margin, and cash — so you can manage the business, not guess.

Cash Flow & Forecasting

Weekly/Monthly cash planning that makes payroll, taxes, and growth investments predictable and calm.

Budgeting & Decision Support

Scenario planning for hiring, pricing, expansion, debt, and big purchases — with numbers that actually hold up.

Benefits

Better Decisions. Stronger Margins. Less Stress.

Fractional CFO support gives you the strategic layer most businesses miss: the “why” behind performance and a plan for what’s next.

And because our pricing is custom-fit, you don’t overpay for a rigid package — you get the level of support that matches your needs right now.

Common outcomes
  • Cleaner monthly financials you can trust
  • Predictable cash position and runway
  • Better pricing and margin visibility
  • Faster, more confident leadership decisions

How it works

Simple, Structured, and Ongoing

We start with your goals and your numbers, then build a reporting + planning rhythm you can actually use.

01

Assess & Align

Review your reporting, systems, and priorities — then define what “good” looks like for leadership.

02

Build the Operating Rhythm

Create dashboards, forecasts, and meeting cadences so you always know what’s happening and what’s coming.

03

Advise & Execute

Ongoing guidance for decisions: hiring, pricing, investments, debt, and planning for the next stage.
